synthetic_policy.validation: Validate complete request/envelope and expected reply size before model mutation. Accepted keys0/1 only, root route exact. Numeric controls accept signed32 integers with source width masks; unsupported/readonly/no-op writes do not gain fake state changes. Reject bool and nonintegral numbers explicitly as safe parser boundary.
synthetic_policy.context: Build full input JSON object once. Native callbacks may inspect Add0.1/Add0.5/TemUn/TemRec, timer pairs, turbo/Quiet ordering and category. Preserve original opt/p arrays and duplicate ordering for ACK; do not use a per-field setter loop with incomplete context.
synthetic_policy.requested: Retain raw ordered p separately; never normalize p to effective/readback values.
synthetic_policy.staging: Apply exact source writer conversion to an outbound tuple list. No-op hour callbacks stage nothing. Unknown category/field and callback failure are not treated as new cache keys.
synthetic_policy.ack: Source constructor uses original opt/p and callback-produced val separately. Final val ordering/content across repeated fields must follow the qualified native res constructor, not dict last-value policy inferred from emulator. Until that wire probe closes, do not claim a full native command round trip.
synthetic_policy.effective: Chosen bounded synthetic board bridge applies successfully staged outputs to paired reported tuples after ACK construction. That lifecycle is explicit model policy, not a physical board confirmation. An input producing no tuple leaves report state unchanged.
synthetic_policy.fresh_status: Run original source getter semantics over independently reported tuples, preserving requested cols/order/duplicates. ADR SetTem22+Add0.5 produces outbound raw5; if the chosen bridge reports5, fresh SetTem is0, while ACKp remains22. This inference combines passed original writer/getter slices with explicit synthetic board policy, not claimed observed firmware LAN calibration.
synthetic_policy.restart: Reset synthetic raw caches to declared defaults; reset pending tuples/report flags and chosen accumulator history. Root seeded identity/key remain stable by model policy. No original persistent-state claim.

transport.codec: AES128-ECB + PKCS7 emit, base64 pack. No authenticated GCM. Native decrypt validates final pad length1..16 only; strict all-pad validation in model is a deliberate safe deviation.

crypto_evidence.native_primitive_boundary: ADR original wrapper calls identified AES block/key schedule and base64 primitives; transport_probe.py substitutes only those primitives while native wrapper executes.

transport.key_routing: Runtime key array: i0 per-device key, i1 generic; both decrypt and reply wrapper index same original envelope i. Negative wrapper i returns unwrapped internal request; safe public model accepts only0/1. Bind requires1 and root mac.
transport.bind: bindOk when subList parameter is string (even empty string), bindok when not string; issued key=array[0], reply forced generic slot1. Existing BR model hardcodes bindOk because its topology model always supplies a child cache.
transport.discovery: dev fields: t,bc,catalog,series,model,lock,vender,mid,name,ver,mac,subCnt; no hid,brand,cid added to inner dev. Scalar values copied from config, not universally fixed vendor defaults.
transport.enumeration: subList/subDev alias; body i is zero-based child offset, five outputs maximum, c is full child count. Plain outer subList dispatches directly and its i also chooses response key. Encrypted pack keeps outer key i separate from inner pagination i. Child cache # separators and | fields produce actual mac/mid entries, not whitelist.
transport.tuple_semantics: Three-byte native tuple is unit/address, opcode, field-index; not a16-bit temperature calibration or descriptor mask. Opcode table yieldsbit/byte/little-endian16 classes. Unit0 is replaced by resolved child address. BR frame beginsAA AA, ADR frame beginsAA (different offsets and event transport).
transport.routing: Status accepts root mac or native substring membership in subList; safe model exact-match rejects native substring ambiguity. cmd alias changes t tores; command uses sub preferentially then mac for child destination and preserves envelope route. Returned child identity is complete seven bytes; binding children as roots not evidenced.
transport.metadata_and_status: dat moves original cols and emits ordered dat array. Unknown requested names initially empty strings and may be delegated through dat callback; do not equate root parameter miss with final child missing property without callback. Child source-defined getters must be supplied bounded synthetic raw cache rather than omitted for lack of physical calibration.
transport.management_surface: Finite dispatcher includes provisioning/cloud/OTA/reporting operations beyond the core emulator contract. Do not implement destructive OTA/reconfiguration or fabricate their success. ADR extra binStatus,binCmd,gbinstatus,Ackup,res_200 remain distinct typed/binary paths.
transport.buffer_bounds: ADR inner serialize allocation0xc00 and outer before-write0x1000 are scratch/serialization sizes, not independently established UDP receive limit; do not reuse RT13 limits1460/1536 or its1000-byte GCM scratch.
transport.source_compatibility: Existing sim-wb05br-v1.31 root/list dialect is exact-source compatible for qualified formats; four-field child cache is intentionally much narrower than54/52/43/9 source descriptors. Existing other BR versions are not reassessed solely by shared family. RT13 is excluded.
